whoWeAre: SHELLCAT is a cybersecurity and technology company focused on helping businesses identify security weaknesses, strengthen their digital infrastructure and build reliable software solutions.
We combine offensive security expertise, practical security assessments and modern software development to help organisations operate with greater confidence in an increasingly connected world.
mission: To make digital systems more secure, resilient and reliable through ethical security testing and innovative technology.
vision: To become a trusted international technology and cybersecurity company recognised for technical excellence, responsible security practices and innovation.
